content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR CFTRI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CFTRI Senior Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Senior Project Associate-I position at CSIR CFTRI is 06 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in Natural Sciences or equivalent with 3 years' experience, or M.E/M. Tech in Biotechnology or equivalent with 3 years' experience, or a Doctoral Degree in Natural Sciences or equivalent with 2 years' experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, with relaxations available for SC/ST/PwBD/Women (5 years) and OBC (3 years).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate-I position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online for the CSIR CFTRI Senior Project Associate-I recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting by a designated committee followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR CFTRI located?
faq.answer: CSIR CFTRI is located in Mysuru, Karnataka, with the pincode 570020.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Senior Project Associate-I position is a temporary job, likely for a specific project duration.
